name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Grasweberhof
beschreibung: The Grasweberhof in Ebbs is a farm that offers holiday apartments. The accommodations are equipped with a kitchen and a private bathroom. The farm is located on the edge of the village with a view of the Kaisergebirge. Guests have the opportunity to experience everyday farm life. Ebbs is located near the border with Deutschland and the town of Kufstein. The region is suitable for hiking and cycling tours. The Inn is not far away either.
